articles.description: Thomas Müller had a goal and an assist, Brian White and Rayan Elloumi each added a goal and the Vancouver Whitecaps beat Sporting Kansas City 3-0 on Saturday night.

articles.headline: U.S. teen Cavan Sullivan makes MLS history with latest goal
articles.description: Philadelphia Union rising star Cavan Sullivan found the net for the second straight match to become the first 16-year-old in MLS history with goal contributions in four consecutive matches.

articles.description: Sam Surridge scored his 13th goal this season and added an assist, Hany Mukhtar also had a goal and an assist, and Nashville SC beat FC Cincinnati 4-0 on Saturday night for its fourth consecutive win.
